topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Oh my god, you won’t believe what just happened. They’re turning our building into condos. Can you even imagine? All of us, scrambling, trying to figure out what this means. My lease, my life here—everything's up in the air. What if I can’t afford to stay? What if I lose this place? The walls that have seen all my late-night movie marathons, the kitchen where we made spaghetti for New Year’s... It's all changing. I don’t know what to do, and everything feels so uncertain right now. We have to talk about this, figure out a plan, maybe there’s something we can do.
